extension.summary: Remove watched media through Sonarr and Radarr after a retention period
extension.description: Checks while Kodi is running, using its internal library API. Defaults to dry run. Explicit path mappings support SMB and NFS sources. Requires your own Sonarr and Radarr servers.
extension.disclaimer: Live mode permanently deletes media. Verify dry-run logs and keep backups. Credentials are stored in local Kodi settings, not encrypted.
